A1.justification: Both complete, readable 21-page PDFs describe AV-Reasoner and CG-AV-Counting. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–C support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, AV-Reasoner experiments, training ablations, and appendix analyses, including Tables 2 and 4–8 and Figures 8–11.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical evaluations and ablations, with revised CG-AV-Counting results.

M1.justification: Both versions use Ola-Omni-7B, the same rewards, cold-start SFT, curriculum-based GRPO with the Stage Review Mechanism, and full-task RL. No algorithm, architecture, or inference procedure changes are documented.

E1.justification: CG-AV-Counting retains 497 videos, 1,027 questions, 5,845 clues, and the same modalities and counting targets. Training datasets and evaluation coverage, including the appendix AVQA and AVE experiments, are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding benchmark tables, ablations, and appendix plots. The revised scores concern existing comparison methods.

E3.justification: The reported full-video, reference-interval, and white-box evaluation procedures, metrics, Appendix A.5 prompts, and Table 9 training configurations are unchanged. The numerical revisions do not establish a change in experimental settings.

E4.justification: Existing training-stage and curriculum/review ablations receive revised evidence in Tables 6–7. For example, the Ref Acc increment from adding full-task RL changes from 1.16 to 0.08 percentage points in Table 6. Figure 11 also revises the targetwise white-box analysis, but no new ablation configurations or analysis types are introduced.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without adding repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The unchanged rollout counts describe training and sample filtering, not uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: Tables 2 and 4–7 substantially revise reference-interval counting scores, WCS, and selected IFA values; Figure 11 also changes. Table 5 revises AV-Reasoner Ref Acc from 23.56 to 35.83 and the Ola baseline from 16.94 to 25.33. Table 2's open-source Ref Acc leader changes from Qwen2.5-Omni-7B to Eagle2.5-8B. Long-video scores and results on other benchmarks remain unchanged. These are revised reported results, without an explained methodological cause.

T1.justification: The WCS definition and its localization/counting components in Equation 1, the counting reward in Equation 2, and other mathematical definitions are unchanged. No proofs or formal results are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same benchmark contribution, curriculum-based capability-transfer claim, strong audio-visual performance claims, and finding that explicit reasoning does not improve out-of-domain performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of alignment, grounding, task transfer, forgetting, and explicit-thinking failures remain unchanged despite the revised scores. The limitations concerning predefined clue frames and reasoning-answer inconsistency are retained.

D1.justification: Appendix B and Table 9 retain the same framework, hardware, sample counts, token budgets, eight rollout trajectories, and KL coefficient. The rollout and KL sentences move from page 21 to page 20; they are not new disclosures. Project access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 65 references and related-work discussion are retained, with unchanged positioning relative to omni-modal models, counting benchmarks, and GRPO-based reasoning methods.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp changes from v1, 5 June 2025, to v2, 22 July 2025. Substantive prose, terminology, headings, and section ordering are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 11 is redrawn: the event-axis maximum increases from 35 to 40, the object/attribute maximum from 0.5 to 0.7, and the Count Target axis title is removed. Legend spacing and appendix pagination change slightly, allowing Appendix B.1 to finish on page 20. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 substantially replaces central benchmark and ablation scores in Tables 2 and 4–7 and Figure 11, but neither PDF explains why the replacements are more reliable. The method, validation coverage, reproducibility information, and interpretations remain unchanged. Higher reported scores and modest layout changes do not establish better paper quality; the supplied evidence cannot determine whether the numerical revisions correct earlier errors.
